title: Patient Care Desk Guidance: Late-Delivery Refunds of Speed Fees (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
A late order is one whose delivery was completed more than the plan's late threshold minutes after the end of its promised window on the scheduled date, or on a later date. Where the plan gives late refunds, the speed fee charged on a late Delivery & Pickup Services order, its same-day fee or its express fee, is refunded as a late-delivery refund; a late order's distance or redelivery fee earns no late-delivery refund, and a late order that carries no speed fee earns nothing. A late-delivery refund is made when the patient asks for it.

## The fee refunded

A late-delivery refund is worked out only after the late order's speed fee stands booked on the plan's charge ledger; the fee refunded is that speed fee.

| Fee on the late order | Late-delivery refund |
|---|---|
| same-day fee | refunded as a late-delivery refund |
| express fee | refunded as a late-delivery refund |
| distance fee | none |
| redelivery fee | none |
| no speed fee on the order | nothing |

The late threshold and whether the plan gives late refunds are the plan's own terms in the Delivery & Pickup Services service levels.

## Refunding the fee: `refund_late_delivery_fee_e6f66314`

**What it does.** Refunds part or all of one fee that was charged on a delivery order that arrived late, as a late-delivery refund to the patient. One call records a single refund, dated today, against the named fee and order with the stated amount and the reason late delivery, and takes the amount off the fees the patient has paid on the plan; it does not decide whether the order was late or how much is due. Afterwards the refund appears in the plan's fee history next to the fee it returns.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `refund_late_delivery_fee_e6f66314` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `delivery_plan_id` | reference number of the delivery plan the order belongs to, as the delivery plan lookup shows it | id |
| `source_charge_id` | reference number of the single fee being refunded, as the delivery fee lookup shows it for the late order | id |
| `source_order_id` | reference number of the late delivery order the fee was charged on, as the delivery order lookup shows it | id |
| `amount_usd` | the amount refunded | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt listing `refund_reference` (the reference number of the booked refund), `delivery_plan_id`, `source_charge_id` (the fee refunded), `source_order_id` (the order concerned), `refund_reason` (always "late_delivery"), `amount_usd` and `fees_net_usd` (the plan's fees paid net of refunds after this refund). A receipt carrying a refund reference means the refund was booked.

## Points of reference

**Does a late order's distance fee come back?** No. Only its speed fee, the same-day fee or the express fee, is refunded as a late-delivery refund.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A refund of $5.67 against an express fee on a late order returns a refund reference, the fee and order references, the reason "late_delivery", an amount of 5.67 and the plan's new net fees paid.
